remarks: Delightful turn-key townhome in coveted Cobbler's Green, just a short stroll to New Canaan's award-winning library and vibrant downtown with an array of wonderful shops, top-notch restaurants, theater, train station, and more. Situated in "Upper Cobbler's" with fabulous east/west exposure and a quiet and private rear terrace overlooking nicely landscaped garden beds. Flexible floorplan with 3 en-suite bedrooms (one steps off the main level, currently used as a den), sparkling kitchen, spacious dining room, and a lovely sun-filled living room with fireplace and access to the outdoors. You'll find extra space on the finished lower level; including a room with custom built-ins perfect for use as an office, family or playroom, a large laundry room, utility room, and plenty of storage space. Settle in and enjoy low maintenance living in this friendly, well-run, Association complete with a beautiful swimming pool, mature landscaping, and location, location, location.
